display_name: Imputed-interest adjustment and corrected sectoral profit rates

triage.reason: HEADLINE MIXED-UNITS FIX. Series interleaves two genuinely different quantities: three dollar imputed-interest adjustments (A-C, billions, can be negative) and four decimal profit rates (D-G, ~0.03-0.19). Under the banned series-level 'mixed_billions_usd_and_decimal_rates' string it rendered as one nonsensical spiky line (the canonical AS003/XS003 failure in UNITS_VALIDATION_STANDARD) and fails gate P14. After per-subseries units the A-C dollar panel and the D-G rate panel each render sensibly one-trace-per-subseries. These corrected profit rates are the empirical objects feeding S601-S604 and Ch16 dynamics.
